drift_row_D1.report: paired difference G - E of T (and of the Driver span and walk_elapsed_ms): median with seeded paired bootstrap 95% CI (seed 20261002, 10000 resamples); expected ~0 because the GTK3 walk takes ~11 ms, far below either budget

browser.COMP_K: COMP minus the OWNER_DECISION knobs (feedback default ON, focus settle default)
browser.lifecycle: fresh Driver, fresh isolated Chromium and fresh token per trial; setup outside T

design.L_scripted: scripted chooser; arms BASE, COMP, COMP_K, COMP_E; 32 rounds; round r: classes rotated (r mod 3), the 4 arms in Williams row (r mod 4) (r2_10_browser.py build_plan, unchanged). Run as 4 chunks S1..S4 of 8 rounds each (start rounds 0, 8, 16, 24) so each EXCLUSIVE acquisition stays under 25 min; the trial sequence equals R2-10's S1/S2 sequence. Chunk S1 holds the training invocation for COMP, COMP_E and COMP_K; later chunks read the routines written by S1.
design.controls_excluded_from_T: chunk N1 (plan controls, 5 rounds): N4a inside COMP 5 per class; OOD 5 (fill routine on the toggle/modal page); N-W2 inside COMP 5; native focus steal block nd1 (5 per task per arm, ~100 ms after the state change); fallback counts in COMP fill from the measured rows
design.native: native-plan.json (unchanged): blocks nm1 and nm2 (12 rounds each, 24 rounds per task, Williams 3-treatment design), nd1 focus steal
design.lock: every measured chunk (D1, S1-S4, N1, nm1, nm2, nd1): cargo-build lock, then bin/quiet-timed EXCLUSIVE, at most 25 min per acquisition, each background job < 2 h; Phase 0 rows and shakedowns: SHARED quiet lock (unit tests: cargo lock first, then SHARED)
design.order_of_work: Phase 0 (a)-(e) -> D1 -> S1..S4 -> N1 -> nm1 -> nm2 -> nd1; every trial and failure kept
design.failed_session_rule: a chunk whose private session fails to start (every trial an error at session level) is kept in raw/, counted, excluded from row evaluation and re-run under a new label

forced_paths: as R2-10 PREREG forced_paths and arm_configuration_checks_browser (unchanged): browser clicks dom_event (receipt route dom, click.cdp_send inside the call), typing browser_type (route recorded, identical across arms); native AT-SPI DoAction / set_value (route accessibility, R2-04 mark sequence in order, knob marks and cursor motion as the arm sets them). A row whose route or arm-configuration marks mismatch is refused (invalid, kept in the denominator).
oracle: independent, target-owned, read every 2 ms by a harness thread (not the runner): browser = jev-use fixture server state with its CLOCK_MONOTONIC mutation journal; native = the GTK3 task state file (CUA_GTK3_TASK_STATE, fresh per trial). D1 has no task outcome; its oracle is the app state file (unchanged by the observation) and the Driver-reported walk fields.
metrics: as R2-10: T0 = send of the first observation; T_oracle (gating) = T0 -> first 2 ms oracle sample at/after the last accepted mutation's return showing the expected final state; T_land = T0 -> first oracle sample showing it; T_runner as R2-10; decomposition as R2-10 (B-01 decompose + B-02 taxonomy; native N-01R boundaries)

statistics.S: per class/task and arm: S = median T_oracle BASE / median T_oracle arm over rounds where both trials are valid; seeded paired bootstrap over rounds (seed 20261002, 10000 resamples, percentile 95% CI). Reported: S_COMP, S_COMP_K, S_COMP_E (scripted); fill S_all (training round charged with compile + admission), amortized ratio of means and warm-only; native S_S0 and S_X; and the same S on T_land next to each.
statistics.decomposition: per component on every arm: mean ms, share of mean T, verdict (R2-10 e2_verdicts_preregistered, unchanged), above-threshold flag (>= 5% or >= 50 ms), floor ratio, untested share; work deleted (BASE - arm component means) separate from wall-clock saved (median paired T_oracle difference)
statistics.denominators: every trial kept; failures stay in validity denominators
statistics.never_compared: R' numbers are never ratioed against R2-10's R numbers; only verdicts are compared

RECERTIFIED_iff_all: validity_100: verified share 1.0 in every arm (scripted 4 arms x 3 classes, native 3 arms x 2 tasks)
e4_zero: 0 E4 violations (stale dispatch, duplicate, unverified success, refusal returned as success, blind replay) in every arm, admission replay and control

S_direction: every R2-10 scripted/native S whose CI excluded 1 again excludes 1 in the same direction (reference/r2-10-reference.json: S_COMP, S_COMP_E, S_COMP_K per class, fill amortized and warm-only, native S_S0 and S_X per task; all 15 R2-10 CIs were above 1)

verdict_mapping: every component keeps its verdict mapping (same verdict label per component and unit) and every component with R2-10 work deleted of magnitude >= 5 ms keeps its sign (deleted stays deleted)
gates.on_failure: RECERT_FAIL naming each claim that changed (recert_gates.py changed_claims)
gates.flagged_not_hidden: a component whose share crosses 5% or 50 ms relative to R2-10 (above_threshold flips) and any change of the E2 untested < 5% status are listed in recert-summary.json and the README

e2_verdicts_preregistered: unchanged from the R2-10 PREREG (analyze_r2_10.py BROWSER_VERDICTS / NATIVE_VERDICTS)
